name: Tiotropium
mechanism: Long-acting muscarinic antagonist (LAMA) - blocks M3 receptors in airways
dosing: COPD: 18mcg daily via HandiHaler or 5mcg daily via Respimat. Take same time each day
monitoring: Lung function, symptoms, anticholinergic side effects, narrow-angle glaucoma
pregnancy: Use only if benefit outweighs risk - limited safety data
sideEffects: Dry mouth, constipation, urinary retention, narrow-angle glaucoma, paradoxical bronchospasm
pharmacokinetics: Long duration of action (24h), minimal systemic absorption
clinicalPearls: Once daily LAMA for COPD. Different devices deliver different doses. Avoid contact with eyes
indication: COPD maintenance therapy, add-on to bronchodilators
